entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie, agent ID 402. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I... I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and it's just... not right. I'm a bit confused by the website.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can I have your name and order number, please?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... VF77819-01.
Thank you, Maria. I see your order for the VeloFit Aero Helmet, delivered six days ago. Could you tell me what specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's a preference, I guess. It's the color. On the website, it looked like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a maroon. It doesn't match my bike at all. The box is unopened, I haven't even touched it.
I understand completely. The color needs to be right, especially for something you'll be wearing every ride. Let me just pull up our return policy for you.
Okay... I just get so overwhelmed with all the rules and things. Can't you just help me? I just want the right one.

Of course, Maria. That's what I'm here for. Let's see... Okay, I'm looking at our policy now. It shows that for a standard item like this helmet, you have 90 days from the delivery date to make a return, as long as the item is in its original condition.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. I was so worried.

Absolutely. Since you received it just six days ago and the box is unopened, you are well within that timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. You just need to print it, attach it to the box, and drop it at any post office.
Wow, that's so much easier than I thought. Thank you, Charlie! You've been a huge help.

You're very welcome, Maria. We want to make sure you're happy and, most importantly, have the right gear for your safety. Once we receive the helmet, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
